/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT SUM(std.TransactionQuantity) RunningQty FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate < @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1)
GO

create FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCostPreviousOp] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT TOP 1 isnull(std.AverageRate, std.TransactionCost)TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE

);

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCostPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT TOP 1 std.TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE

/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:46 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT SUM(std.TransactionQuantity) RunningQty FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate < @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT SUM(std.TransactionQuantity) RunningQty FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate < @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1)
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCostPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT TOP 1 std.TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate < @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT SUM(std.TransactionQuantity) RunningQty FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate < @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1)
GO

/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);

/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_StockRunningBalanceQtyPrevious] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT SUM(std.TransactionQuantity) RunningQty FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <> 'No Impact' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate < @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1)
GO

/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'ufn_GetLastStockCost') AND xtype IN (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF') ) DROP FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] GO
/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] Script Date: 3/13/2017 4:08:11 PM ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCost] (@ItemID INT,@LocationID INT,@DocumentDate datetime) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
SELECT top 1 Avg((case when std.valuechange is not null or std.valuechange <>0 then ((std.transactionquantity * std.TransactionCost) + std.valuechange) / std.transactionquantity else std.transactioncost end)) TransactionCost FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail std INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader sth ON sth.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = std.PeriodID AND sth.StockTransactionID = std.StockTransactionID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID AND ( SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact = 'Positive' ) INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = std.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = std.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- AND ( INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0 ) WHERE
std.ItemID = @ItemID AND isnull(std.LocationID,sth.LocationID) = @LocationID AND sth.DocumentDate <= @DocumentDate AND std.Status = 1 group by std.ItemID,sth.StockTransactionID ,sth.DocumentDate ORDER BY sth.DocumentDate DESC
);
GO

create FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_GetLastStockCostPreviousIFNULL] ( @ItemID INT , @LocationID INT , @DocumentDate DATETIME ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN
(
(SELECT * FROM ufn_GetLastStockCostPrevious(@ItemID, @LocationID, @DocumentDate))
);
